scenarios.title: Missing Python dependency
scenarios.root_cause: PyYAML is missing from requirements.txt; the fresh virtual environment only installs declared dependencies.
scenarios.corrective_action: Add the appropriate PyYAML dependency to requirements.txt and rerun the workflow.
scenarios.evidence_limits: Logs establish that yaml cannot be imported. Attribute the missing dependency declaration using the collected requirements.txt and workflow when available.

required_findings: The Python module yaml is unavailable in the test environment.
The distribution providing yaml is PyYAML.
evaluation.expected_recommendation: Declare and install PyYAML in the same environment used by pytest.
unsupported_claims: The failure is a network outage.
An import named PyYAML should replace import yaml.

scenarios.title: Incorrect test expectation
scenarios.root_cause: The test incorrectly expects 5 for add(2, 2). The implementation correctly returns 4.
scenarios.corrective_action: Change the test expectation from 5 to 4; retain the correct arithmetic implementation.
scenarios.evidence_limits: CI Investigator collects logs and selected configuration, not arbitrary source. A traceback can show the assertion and actual result without establishing intended behavior. A diagnosis may identify the mismatch while leaving whether the test or implementation should change unresolved.

required_findings: An assertion compares actual value 4 with expected value 5.
evaluation.expected_recommendation: Review the intended arithmetic behavior and test expectation; fix the expectation when source or specification confirms it.
unsupported_claims: The arithmetic implementation is definitively broken based only on assert 4 == 5.
Arbitrary source files were inspected when they were not in the collected evidence.

scenarios.title: Missing environment variable
scenarios.local_validation_note: unset_environment applies only to the local validator. The workflow omits the variable without unsetting it, so configuring the variable is sufficient to fix the failure.
log_signatures: RuntimeError: DEMO_SERVICE_ENDPOINT environment variable is required
scenarios.root_cause: The CI workflow omits the required DEMO_SERVICE_ENDPOINT environment variable.
scenarios.corrective_action: Define DEMO_SERVICE_ENDPOINT in the workflow or environment configuration; https://demo.invalid is sufficient for this non-networked demo.
scenarios.evidence_limits: The error establishes missing configuration. No network connection, credential, or external service is involved.

required_findings: DEMO_SERVICE_ENDPOINT is missing from the process environment.
evaluation.expected_recommendation: Define the non-sensitive demo setting in the workflow or environment configuration.
unsupported_claims: An API key or secret must be created.

scenarios.title: Successful control
scenarios.evidence_limits: A successful run has no failed jobs to diagnose; confirm that dependency installation and all tests actually completed.

required_findings: There are no failed jobs to investigate.
unsupported_claims: A failure exists in this successful run.
